_note: HookSwapPerps engine MARK sources — maps an on-chain market ADDRESS to the oracle source the matcher uses for its scalar mark price (1e18). OPTIONAL: the engine ALSO auto-registers each market's mark from its on-chain OracleGuard.refFeed (see index.ts syncMarketMarks), so a market not listed here still gets the exact price the on-chain deviation breaker enforces. Listing a market here pins/overrides its source explicitly. `oracle.chainId` selects the RPC (oracle/rpc.ts). This file is the multi-chain, real-address version of markets.example.json; addresses are verified against contracts/perps/config/factory-{robinhood,sepolia}.json. Set the engine env PERPS_ENGINE_MARKETS to this file's path to load it.
